title: Hearty Peppery Moroccan Cauliflower Couscous Royal
description: A satvik-friendly, nostalgic Moroccan dish featuring cauliflower, with a peppery flavor and a bouncy texture, cured with yuzu, served in a royal couscous form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cauliflower florets with olive oil, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt until they are evenly coated.
Spread the cauliflower mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the cauliflower is roasting, cook the couscous according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yuzu juice and a pinch of salt.
Once the cauliflower is done roasting, remove it from the oven and toss it with the yuzu juice mixture until the cauliflower is evenly coated.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked couscous on a large platter or individual plates, then top with the roasted cauliflower mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and mint.
